messages.subject: Error Message
parts:
Hi-

I was successfully using the code in codex_targeted.R until I encountered an error message with the code on line 91 (included below):

Link:

https://github.com/yuchaojiang/CODEX/blob/master/targeted_sequencing/codex_targeted.R

Line 91:
 
 qcObj=qc(Y,sampname,chr,ref,mapp,gc,cov_thresh=c(60,4000),length_thresh=c(20,2000),mapp_thresh=0.9,gc_thresh=c(20,80))


Error Message:

Error in apply(Y_qc, 1, median) : dim(X) must have a positive length


Any suggestions for troubleshooting this error?

Thank you,
Margaret

messages.subject: Re: [codex_wes_cnv] Error Message

Please check that your matrix Y is a matrix and that Y, as well as the vectors sampname, ref, mapp, gc have the same dimension.

Yuchao
